issue.title: parseConfig throws on an empty file instead of returning the defaults
issue.body:
`parseConfig` in src/parse-config.js throws a TypeError when the config file is empty or contains a blank line, because `line.split("=")` yields `[""]` and the code then calls `.trim()` on an undefined value.

`node --test test/parse-config.test.js` fails on "returns the defaults for an empty file" and "skips a blank line between entries".

Expected: an absent or empty file means no overrides, so the caller gets the defaults back, and a blank line between entries is skipped rather than treated as a key.
